---
title: "Printable PDFs"
description: "Every chapter as its own PDF, for reading on paper."
execute:
  freeze: false
---

Each chapter is also available as its own PDF, with dense margins and no code, made for
printing. Animations appear as frame strips (snapshots at chosen moments).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import re, yaml
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("..") if Path("../chapters").exists() else Path(".")
part = None
for qmd in sorted((root / "chapters").rglob("*.qmd")):
    if not (root / "planning" / "reviews" / f"{qmd.stem[:5]}.done").exists():
        continue
    m = re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---", qmd.read_text(), re.S)
    fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1)) if m else {}
    if qmd.parent.name != part:
        part = qmd.parent.name
        print(f"\n### {part.split('-', 1)[1].replace('-', ' ').title()}\n")
    print(f"- [{fm.get('title', qmd.stem)}](../pdfs/{qmd.stem}.pdf)")
```
